stories.story: Lily wanted to eat the bread, but a kitten shivered on a high ledge. Lily said, “The kitten needs help.” Dad said, “I can lower the basket.” Lily said, “I can share the bread.” Lily put the bread in the basket. Dad carried the basket to the window, and he lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Lily waited because the kitten was frightened. The kitten entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Dad lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Lily carried the kitten into the cottage, and she wrapped the kitten in the warm blanket. Lily was hungry, but the kitten rested in the warm blanket.

Ben wanted to eat the bread, but a rabbit shivered on a high ledge. Ben said, “The rabbit needs help.” Mum said, “I can climb the ladder.” Ben said, “I can steady the ladder.” Ben fetched the ladder from the shed, and he steadied the ladder. Mum climbed the ladder, and she lifted the rabbit down. Ben carried the rabbit into the cottage, and he wrapped the rabbit in the warm blanket. The rabbit rested in the warm blanket.
